system.effect: Gain a +1 Condition bonus to Crafting checks to repair hand-held objects or small mechanical components. This does not provide tools, parts, magic-item creation, or knowledge you have not acquired.
system.description: You can hold the whole arrangement of a small mechanism in your head while your hands set it right.
system.automation: [EFFECT CHECK: 1 condition, repair; IF: CLAIM(hand-held objects or small mechanical components)]
